items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I was still with the Lusianans... I stayed with him longer than I did any band in Chicago... He was a little band, we were just all boys from New Orleans

ctx.x: And who, which other bands were you working with while you were working with Dave Payton?

Well, to tell the truth, I was still with the Lusianans. Mm-hmm. But Dave Payton was just getting up a, what do you call it, something like an all-star band to make a big opening there, see. Mm-hmm. And he made that big opening for two days, Saturday and Sunday I think it was. All day Sunday and Saturday night. And then after that he had got his regular band, you know, what he wanted there, but I was still with Francois Lusianan. Mm-hmm. Yeah. I see. So, how many years were you with Francois? Well I'm going to be…
What year was it you took sick? Do you remember?
